title: Pablo Escobar's 4 Hippos Are Now About 200 Wild Hippos

scenes.text: Four hippos from one man's zoo became a herd of 200.
In 1981, Pablo Escobar imported four hippos for his private zoo in Colombia.
They escaped into the river and spread up to 60 miles from the ranch.
Colombia is now the only country in South America with wild hippos.
Today around 200 roam free, and the number keeps growing.
In 2026, Colombia approved killing more than 80 of them.

description:
Four hippos from one man's zoo became a herd of 200.
Pablo Escobar imported four hippos in 1981. Their descendants now number around 200 in Colombia, the only South American country with wild hippos. In April 2026 the government approved removing more than 80.
What should Colombia do about them? Comment below.
first_comment: Hippos can't be sent back to Africa because of their small gene pool and diseases they may carry. What would you do?
